findings.issue: The library's own address is 0 in this pre-deployment bytecode, so the delegatecall-only guard reads 'require this.address' (as in c00063).

findings.decompiled: create2 contract with 0 wei / salt: _param6 / code: Bytes(23, _param8 >> 136 | 0x3d602d80600a3d3981f3363d3d373d3d3d363d73000000), Bytes(17, uint136(_param8)), Bytes(15, 0x5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3)
findings.issue: The 20-byte implementation address inside the clone init code is split across two slices (3 bytes OR-ed into the 23-byte prefix, 17 bytes after), so the standard minimal-proxy code is not recognisable at a glance.
findings.rule: Concatenate code bytes by byte ranges: 'Bytes(23, a >> 136 | P << 24 ...), Bytes(17, uint136(a))' is 'Bytes(20, P), address(a)'.

notes: Library SiloVaultFactoryActionsLib. The pack lists only initCodeHash(bytes) (correct: keccak256 of the embedded SiloVault creation code code.data[1775 len 22696] and the arguments); createSiloVault, decompiled as 0x2689beca without an ABI entry, was reviewed too: argument decoding (3 address-array decode loops), the deterministic clone of the incentives module (create2, FailedDeployment 0xb06ebf3d on failure), new SiloVault{salt} with the constructor arguments, and __VaultIncentivesModule_init (0xf9d96614) with the three re-encoded arrays (3 encode loops: P7); all correct.
